name: cache-ttl-timer
description: See how long your prompt cache has left before it expires, so you can time your next message before the conversation needs to be cached again.
sourceDescription: A prompt-cache countdown in the prompt footer, beside the model and effort: how long until your next message has to re-cache the whole conversation.
author: Seongje Hong

category.label: Memory Mods
category.basis: Manages context, cache, saved notes or session handoffs.
